_doc: DAMAC buying-entity defaults. Confirm the entity against the project -- DAMAC contracts through several entities and the wrong one invalidates the PO. All entities listed here are members of the DAMAC Development (LLC) VAT group, so they share TRN 100277223200003 (FTA certificate of 01/04/2026). Aqua Viridis had its own TRN 104326385200003 before joining the group on 01/04/2026.
